## The DKW Inequality

The Dvoretzky-Kiefer-Wolfowitz inequality provides non-parametric confidence bands for the empirical CDF:

$$P\left(\sup_x |F_n(x) - F(x)| > \epsilon\right) \leq 2\exp(-2n\epsilon^2)$$

```{r load}
library(dkw)
```

## Computing DKW Bands

```{r dkw-example}
set.seed(123)

# Generate sample from standard normal
n <- 200
x <- rnorm(n)

# Compute ECDF
x_sorted <- sort(x)
Fhat <- ecdf(x)(x_sorted)

# Compute 95% DKW bands
bands <- dkw_band(Fhat, alpha = 0.05, n = n)

cat("DKW bandwidth (epsilon):", round(bands$epsilon, 4), "\n")
```

## Visualizing DKW Bands

```{r plot-dkw}
# Plot ECDF with bands
plot(x_sorted, Fhat, type = "s", lwd = 2,
     ylim = c(0, 1), xlab = "x", ylab = "F(x)",
     main = "DKW Confidence Bands (95%)")

# Add bands
lines(x_sorted, bands$lower, col = "red", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
lines(x_sorted, bands$upper, col = "red", lty = 2, lwd = 2)

# Add true CDF for comparison
curve(pnorm(x), add = TRUE, col = "blue", lwd = 2)

legend("bottomright",
       c("Empirical CDF", "DKW Bands", "True CDF"),
       col = c("black", "red", "blue"),
       lty = c(1, 2, 1), lwd = 2)
```

## Effect of Sample Size

```{r sample-size-effect, fig.height=4}
par(mfrow = c(1, 3))

for (n in c(50, 200, 1000)) {
  x <- rnorm(n)
  x_sorted <- sort(x)
  Fhat <- ecdf(x)(x_sorted)
  bands <- dkw_band(Fhat, alpha = 0.05, n = n)

  plot(x_sorted, Fhat, type = "s", ylim = c(0, 1),
       main = paste("n =", n), xlab = "x", ylab = "F(x)")
  lines(x_sorted, bands$lower, col = "red", lty = 2)
  lines(x_sorted, bands$upper, col = "red", lty = 2)
  curve(pnorm(x), add = TRUE, col = "blue")
}
```

## DKW Bands for Treatment/Control Groups

```{r treatment-control}
# Generate treatment experiment data
result <- get_bounds(m = 200, p = 0.5, alpha = 0.1, tau = 2, rho = 0.3)

# Compute separate DKW bounds
dkw_result <- compute_dkw_bounds(
  obs_Y1 = result$obs_Y1,
  obs_Y0 = result$obs_Y0,
  alpha = 0.1
)

cat("Treatment group (n =", length(result$obs_Y1), "):\n")
cat("  Bandwidth:", round(dkw_result$epsilon1, 4), "\n")

cat("Control group (n =", length(result$obs_Y0), "):\n")
cat("  Bandwidth:", round(dkw_result$epsilon0, 4), "\n")
```

## Plotting Both Groups

```{r plot-both-groups, fig.height=4}
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))

# Treatment group
Y1_sorted <- dkw_result$obs_Y1_sorted
plot(Y1_sorted, dkw_result$ecdf_Y1, type = "s",
     main = "Treatment Group", xlab = "Y(1)", ylab = "F(y)")
lines(Y1_sorted, dkw_result$bounds[[2]], col = "blue", lty = 2)
lines(Y1_sorted, dkw_result$bounds[[1]], col = "red", lty = 2)

# Control group
Y0_sorted <- dkw_result$obs_Y0_sorted
plot(Y0_sorted, dkw_result$ecdf_Y0, type = "s",
     main = "Control Group", xlab = "Y(0)", ylab = "F(y)")
lines(Y0_sorted, dkw_result$bounds[[4]], col = "blue", lty = 2)
lines(Y0_sorted, dkw_result$bounds[[3]], col = "red", lty = 2)
```
